about: Board 2's own words and the files each panel reads. work/build/scripts/phase-3/board_2_build.py reads this file on every run; every number, picture and quoted word on the board comes from the files named under slots, read at build time. A {name} in a sentence is filled from those files. Codes in a 'refs' field print only in the small reference lines. The editor owns these words once the first full build lands; the data lead's decisions file holds panel 1's items and panel 4's counts.
title: Edition 06 Board 2

cover.title: Chapter 14’s forms, rounds 1 to 3
deck: Rounds 1 to 3 built {n_forms} of chapter 14’s forms in {n_fams} families: {n_spec_rows} with a chart and {n_sketches} with a sketch. You answered five questions before this board, and it shows each answer done beside what it replaced.
Panel 1 asks only what is still open. The panels after it are for reference, from every form at true size on both grounds to the scores and what was tested.
cover.minutes: Panel 1 takes about fifteen minutes to read and answer. Pictures show at true size; where one is wider than your window, its frame scrolls sideways.

owners.cd_board: the creative director’s score of this board

decide.title: What you decide
decide.lede: Each item opens with its answer and the studio’s recommendation, then shows the pictures it needs. Items marked “You decide” are still open; the rest are your answers from before the board, shown done beside what they replaced.
decide.wait: Waiting for the data lead’s decisions file. This panel fills in when it lands.
decide.approval_one: One approval covers every item in this group.
decide.entry_link: Open Rule {rule} in the guide preview
decide.reply: To answer, reply “As recommended”, or name the item and your change.

forms.title: The {n_forms} forms by family
forms.lede: This panel shows every form rounds 1 to 3 built, in the plan’s order: {n_spec_rows} forms with a chart, drawn from {n_specs} charts, and {n_sketches} with a sketch. Within each family, a form to avoid comes first.
forms.how: Each chart shows as the guide draws it at a 1440 px window and a 390 px window, at true size, first on Newsprint and then on Charcoal; a fold under them holds both grounds in grayscale. Under the pictures sit the source line as printed, the bytes the chart adds to the page, and its table as text in a second fold. Each heading links to the form’s live entry in the guide preview.
forms.lede_est: The guide labels {n_est_w} of these charts Estimate, in Rules {est_rules}, and the board shows that label as the guide prints it.
forms.question: Reader question
forms.wait_photo: Waiting for a passing guide build and this sketch’s photograph.

forms.b1_unknown: A board 1 chart. The build could not compare its drawing with board 1’s.
forms.shared_spec: The same chart serves Rule {rule}, shown above.

forms.label_phone: At a 390 px window · {px} px drawing

rules.title: Rules 14.1 to 14.14 and the opener
rules.lede: These are the fourteen rules every chart follows, as rounds 1 to 3 left them. Each shows its title with its correct and failure plates, photographed from today’s build at a 1440 px window.
rules.wait: Waiting for the photographs of this rule’s plates.

count.title: Examples by topic and by place
count.lede: Rule 01.9 keeps the guide’s examples from leaning on one topic or one state: no topic of the atlas holds more than one example in four, and no state more than one in five. The data lead recounted chapter 14’s examples by script.

scores.title: Scores
scores.lede: The creative director scores each round’s work on six criteria from 1 to 5, and an item is ready when every score is 4 or more with no Must fix open. Three reviewers also read each round, each for one part of the work, named in the table below.
scores.legend: Each cell gives the first score, small, then the score after the fix pass. A box marks a score under 4.
